The ConnectRPC service clients are created in the frontend source file:

**`web/src/connect.ts`**

This file contains all the service client instantiations using the `createClient` function from the `@connectrpc/connect` package. The following service clients are created:
- `instanceServiceClient` (line 192)
- `authServiceClient` (line 193)
- `userServiceClient` (line 194)
- `memoServiceClient` (line 197)
- `attachmentServiceClient` (line 198)
- `aiServiceClient` (line 199)
- `shortcutServiceClient` (line 200)
- `identityProviderServiceClient` (line 203)
